verdict.rationale: Sketch's docs confirm that documents have a version history and that you can star versions to mark important milestones, which also controls what Viewers and Guests see and which versions become Library updates. A community comment notes the zipped-JSON file format makes git-based versioning possible, but only as a do-it-yourself workaround. missing for 10: explicit naming of versions, a compare/diff between versions, restoring an earlier version, evidence that the full history is retained, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
